heading: ## Scenario: an unresolved sibling_work_item dependency fails closed while a missing local id does not block
reason: Consumer-tier test whose manifest Given is PINNED AS LOAD-BEARING. resolve_ref's _resolve_sibling_work_item short-circuits to UNKNOWN when the repo is absent from manifest.targets, BEFORE the injected lookup is consulted, so a version lacking the Given would pass its CLOSED leg for the wrong reason. A recording lookup makes the difference observable: with the repo declared the lookup IS called (UNKNOWN blocks, CLOSED clears), and against an empty manifest the same CLOSED lookup is never called and the item stays blocked. A ready item whose depends_on names a local id absent from the index is asserted ready.
